$comment: THE ROSTER. Single source of truth for the sponsor wall, on every surface. Add a member and it appears on the vfairness offering page, the vfairness docs landing, the platform app and the platform docs landing, with no other edit. Only tiers that carry PUBLIC NAMING appear here: Supporters fund the work but are not listed, because naming everyone who pays anything would publish how much comes in. Slots are how many placements the wall shows; open ones render as available inventory rather than as absence.
